title: GoRuCo 2012 Hexagonal Rails by Matt Wynne
summary: Matt Wynne's GoRuCo 2012 talk on why Rails apps get hard to change as they grow, and how a ports-and-adapters hexagonal architecture separates application logic from the framework.
why: HN cites it as a resource for decoupling Rails code and for faster tests.

quote.text: I'd recommend watching (Hexagonal Rails GoRuCo talk) for one way to re-architect
